messages:
olivia_finance: Heads up — we've added a temporary 'Pilot 10%' tier into the pricing system for qualified POCs. This is a small rate patch (v3.2-pilot). Need Deal Desk + Legal ack before teams start quoting.

raj_sales: Which customers qualify? expiration window?

olivia_finance: Qualification: projected < $50k ARR over 12 months, standard TOU (no enterprise addenda), POC length <= 3 months. Expiry: quotes issued before 2026-05-01 and signed within 45 days. We'll grandfather active POCs that were signed before the patch goes live.

mike_dealdesk: Can you provide exact quote metadata we should require so ops/finance can detect the discount automatically?

olivia_finance: Yes — include these fields in the quote payload (example below):
```
rate_card_version: v3.2-pilot
rate_modifier: -10%
pilot_tag: poc_qualified
pilot_expiry_ts: 1718630400
```
Also add DealDesk: true and Approvals: finance,legal in the quote notes.

sarah_salesops: I'll update the SFDC quote template and add validation rules to require the DealDesk flag for pilot-rate quotes.

jen_legal: Quick read — looks fine. We need a short clause in SOW/quote: "pilot discounts expire per attached ratecard patch" and ensure no data-residency carve-outs slip in. I'll add that clause and cc Olivia.

olivia_finance: Thanks Jen. One exception: the HealthTech pilot we've been discussing has legacy commit language; we should not auto-apply the pilot discount there. @emma can you confirm?

emma: Confirmed — we'll do manual review for that account and escalate to finance if needed.

pricing-bot: automated note: created ratecard shard v3.2-pilot (id: rc-20260321-pilot)

raj_sales: Do we need to notify customers who already have pending quotes? I have Acme & Numa POCs in the pipeline.

olivia_finance: If a quote was already created with the previous rate, do not change it. For any new quote, use v3.2-pilot only after Deal Desk tag + approvals are present. If in doubt, route to #deal-desk.

mike_dealdesk: I'll create a Deal Desk checklist and set a 24h SLA for approvals on pilot discounts. Will add tasks for Finance verification and Legal clause confirmation. @jen_legal @olivia_finance anything else to include?

jen_legal: Add explicit "no sublicensing or transfer" language for pilot discounts. Done.

olivia_finance: Great — I'll draft an internal announcement for later today with the exact quoting steps and a short FAQ. For now please route all pilot-discount requests to #deal-desk and label them `pilot`. Thanks! :thumbsup:
_notes: Single-thread Slack export: root + replies in chronological order. Messages are Slack-style short lines, include code block for quote metadata.
